script.direction: The hook above is the first spoken line of the take. Speak it and continue straight into the script below, it is all one take.

script.line: It's not about finding more hours, because you haven't got them. It's about building the training around the week you've actually got, so it holds when things get busy.

concepts.name: Social Proof (Client Interview)

concepts.angle: A real client tells their own story, guided by the coach's questions
concepts.intro: This is an interview, not a script to read. The coach asks the questions off camera and the client answers in their own words; the notes under each question say what to guide them to mention. Hook 1 is always the client's introduction line. Hooks 2 and 3 below are examples of the kind of lines to pull, the real ones come from the strongest moments in the client's actual answers during the edit. Repeat the same question set with a few different clients so each interview becomes its own ad variant.
hooks: Hi, I'm [NAME] and I've been training at Northside Strength for the past year.

script.label: Hook
script.direction: The hook above is the first spoken line of the take. Speak it and continue straight into the script below, it is all one take.

script.label: Question 1, before
script.direction: The coach asks off camera: what was training like before you came here? Guide them to mention the stopping and starting and what they had already tried.

script.label: Question 2, the turning point
script.direction: The coach asks: what changed once you started? Guide them to mention the plan being built around their real week and the weekly review keeping it honest.

script.label: Question 3, life now
script.direction: The coach asks: what does training look like now? Guide them to name how often they train and one thing outside the gym that feels different.

script.label: Question 4, who it's for
script.direction: The coach asks: who would you recommend this to? Guide them toward busy people who are done starting over.

steps.label: STEP 1: HOOK, WHO THIS IS FOR
steps.direction: Straight to camera, direct and warm.
lines: If you're a busy professional in your 30s or 40s who wants strength that lasts, but your training keeps slipping when work takes over, give me a minute.
I coach people just like you to get strong around a full schedule, and it starts with a private audit.

steps.label: STEP 2: WHY THIS KEEPS HAPPENING
steps.direction: Empathetic, in their own daily language.
lines: I see it all the time. You start strong, then a heavy week takes over and training is the first thing to drop.
You've had the drive all along, what's been missing is a plan built around your real week.

steps.label: STEP 3: WHAT YOU GET IN YOUR AUDIT
steps.direction: Sell the audit itself and what they walk out with, not the full program.
lines: So here's where we start. A private Strength and Lifestyle Audit, one to one with me.
We go through your week and your training, and I map out a plan built around your real schedule.
You leave with a personalised plan to keep, whatever you decide to do next.

steps.label: STEP 4: WHO I AM
lines: I rebuilt my own training around a demanding career, so I know exactly what it takes.
I've helped busy professionals get strong and keep it up for years, around full diaries and family.
This is what I do, and I'll show you how it works in your audit.

steps.label: STEP 5: HOW TO CLAIM IT
steps.direction: One clear instruction, point them to the form below.
lines: I only take a limited number of audits each month, so if you want one, now is the time.
Register your details in the form just below this video, and I'll be in touch to book your audit.
Fill in your details below, and let's map your plan.

messages.note: Confirm the enquiry, introduce yourself, no link on the cold send.
messages.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, this is Coach Sam at Northside Strength. Thanks for reaching out about your audit. I will call you shortly to find a time that works. Cheers, Sam

messages.subject: Welcome to Northside Strength
messages.note: Warm welcome, set the next step, include the booking link.
messages.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, thanks for enquiring. Your Strength and Lifestyle Audit is a private session where we map a plan around your real week. Pick a time that suits you and we will take it from there. Cheers, Sam

messages.subject: How we coach here
messages.note: Explain the philosophy and what makes it different.
messages.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, we build training around your life, not the other way round. Small, repeatable steps that hold up on busy weeks. That is what makes the audit worth your time. Cheers, Sam

messages.note: Friendly nudge with the booking link.
messages.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, did you get a chance to read my email? Happy to answer anything. Book your audit: northsidestrength.co/audit Cheers, Sam

messages.subject: From skipping sessions to steady weeks
messages.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, when Mara started she trained twice in a good month. We built a plan around school runs and shift work, and now she trains three times a week without the guilt. Your audit is where we map the same for you. Cheers, Sam

messages.subject: The fix for the 6pm energy dip
messages.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, most people blame willpower for the evening slump. Usually it is protein and steps earlier in the day. Small change, steady energy. We cover the rest on your audit. Cheers, Sam

messages.note: Zero-pressure check in, offer to help.
messages.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, just checking in. Any questions about the audit or how we coach? Reply here and I will help. Cheers, Sam

messages.subject: What the programme involves
messages.note: FAQ: pricing, commitment, who it is for.
messages.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, a few common questions before the audit. Sessions run weekly, you choose two or three slots, and coaching is month to month. It suits people who want a plan that fits a full life. We confirm the details on the call. Cheers, Sam

messages.subject: A year of steady progress
messages.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, Dan came in wanting to keep up with his kids. Twelve months on he is stronger than in his twenties and still training around a full diary. The audit is the first step he took. Cheers, Sam

messages.note: Final short-term follow up before nurture.
messages.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, I will ease off the messages now. If you want to map your plan, your audit is here: northsidestrength.co/audit Cheers, Sam

messages.subject: Mara's full year
messages.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, a year ago Mara trained twice a month. Today it is three solid sessions a week, fitted around shifts and school runs. The plan grew with her life. Cheers, Sam

messages.subject: Do you need to train every day
messages.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, a common myth is that progress needs daily training. Two or three focused sessions a week, done consistently, carry most people a long way. Cheers, Sam

messages.subject: Why we coach for the long run
messages.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, quick fixes fade. We coach for results that hold up across years, built around a life you actually live. That is the difference you feel by month three. Cheers, Sam

messages.subject: The numbers behind a steady year
messages.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, Dan added real strength across twelve months, kept every session inside a full work diary, and has not looked back. Measured, steady, repeatable. Cheers, Sam

messages.subject: Is now a better time
messages.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, it has been a while. If the timing feels better now, I would still love to map your plan. No rush, just an open door. Cheers, Sam
